requirement: Tracy AI is an entry of the AI account order: last by default, a new connection stands before it, a conversation on Tracy AI by configuration follows the order, and the saved order must name every connection and Tracy AI exactly once

oracle.invariant: An account with nothing connected has Tracy AI as its whole order and the status carries no tracyFallback. A new connection stands before Tracy AI while Tracy AI is last, else after everything. PUT /api/seat-plan/routing refuses an order that misses a connection or Tracy AI, or names one twice; a tracyFallback field is ignored. A subscription after Tracy AI in the order is not tried when the one before it hits its limit; Tracy AI first pins the conversation to Tracy AI at once and it stays there while Tracy AI stays first; once a subscription is put first, a conversation on Tracy AI by configuration follows. An account with no connection at all keeps the plain pin (the deployment default, no broker turn). Migration 095 gives every saved order Tracy AI once, turns automatic switching back on, and keeps the old column nullable.
